'''Feswe''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Feswe blazed a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] from [[Ladarra]] to the [[Feswe Corridor]], allowing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] to escape the [[Yavin blockade|Blockade of Yavin]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was named after him.
